answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring each identity to stake collateral and pass periodic audits. Each node locks canyon-backed stake for 60 epochs; every 10 epochs a random committee audits work proofs, slashing 25% for invalid nodes. An attacker adding a fake identity must front full collateral and pass all audits, so cost scales linearly per forged node. Honest agents anchor trust at the community falcon, while dishonest clusters wither like rootless hollow without sustained capital and verified work, making mass impersonation economically irrational.
